input_roles.forecast_dataset: structured post-extraction forecast features; not a CAME prediction
input_roles.internal_attribution: structured post-extraction attribution features and typed-retrieval pointer
input_roles.stat_anchor_candidates: author-generated statistical candidates used by online anchor selection
input_roles.normalized_native_forward_cards: structured forward cards with source text withheld and opaque overlap tokens
input_roles.typed_retrieval: structured context cards with source text withheld and opaque overlap tokens
input_roles.ram_proposal_input: frozen precomputed no-guidance proposal consumed by anchor memory; not the final CAME prediction; compatibility identifiers are defined in GLOSSARY.md

final_prediction_input_policy: forbidden; final CAME predictions are comparison-only outside replay_inputs
opaque_token_contract: one unreleased persistent HMAC key with domain separation was shared across native and retrieval cards; only 24-hex token and identifier values are published
